entry.title: Feature: New Configuration Fields Added

entry.content:
New Features:

  • Configurable metrics server address: Made the manager's built-in metrics server bind address configurable.
  • Brownfield state comparison: Added a generic helper function to compare desired and actual states in brownfield resources, improving reconciliation reliability.
  • Irregular shortname pluralization: Added support for irregular shortname pluralization of "corpus" to "corpora".
entry.summary: This release introduces configurable metrics server addresses for improved flexibility. It also enhances reconciliation reliability with a new brownfield state comparison helper and adds support for irregular pluralization of 'corpus' to 'corpora'.
entry.title: Feature: Enhanced Manager Capabilities Released

entry.content:
Reconciliation Improvements:

We have added support for direct reconciliation to more resources, with opt-in behavior. The API is unchanged. To use the direct reconciler, add the cnrm.cloud.google.com/reconciler: direct annotation to the corresponding Config Connector object.

  • NetworkServicesHTTPRoute
  • Support direct reconciliation (opt-in).
entry.summary: Config Connector now supports direct reconciliation for additional resources, including NetworkServicesHTTPRoute. This feature is opt-in and can be enabled by adding the `cnrm.cloud.google.com/reconciler: direct` annotation to your Config Connector objects. The API remains the same.
entry.title: Change: Direct Reconciliation Support Added

entry.content:
Bug Fixes:

  • ComposerEnvironment

  • Improved reconciliation, diffing, and update logic for ComposerEnvironment in the direct reconciler. (GitHub PR #12364)

  • Skip the update of a ComposerEnvironment when the state of the underlying Google Cloud Composer environment is not RUNNING. (GitHub PR #12365)

  • ComputeReservation

  • Ignore diff for specificReservation.inUseCount to prevent infinite/unwanted reconciliations.

  • RedisInstance

  • Marked MaintenanceSchedule field as output only to align with GCP's behavior.

  • SQLInstance

  • Fixed legacy fuzzer roundtrip mismatch for PscAutoConnectionPolicyEnabled.

  • CloudFunctions2Function

  • Declared source fields mutable-but-unreadable to avoid spurious diffs.
entry.summary: This release includes several bug fixes across various services. Improvements have been made to ComposerEnvironment reconciliation and update logic. ComputeReservation diffing has been refined, and RedisInstance maintenance schedules are now correctly marked as output-only. SQLInstance and CloudFunctions2Function also receive fixes for reconciliation and diffing issues.
entry.title: Fixed: Bug fixes for Composer, Compute, Redis, SQL, and Cloud Functions

entry.content:
Bug Fixes:

  • ComposerEnvironment: Fix storageConfig.bucketRef mapping.
  • MemorystoreInstance: Prevent infinite reconciliation drift loop by aligning connections list length.
  • MemorystoreInstance: Prevent false drift and update attempts on unspecified immutable fields.
  • ComputeBackendService: Fix config-connector export tool to export backend field.
  • KMSAutokeyConfig: Clean up and improve autokey config identity and deletion resolution.
  • BigQuery: Fix perpetual diff on tables inheriting dataset encryption.
  • NotebooksInstance: Fix direct controller for NotebookInstance to resolve references.
entry.summary: This release includes several bug fixes across multiple resources, including ComposerEnvironment, MemorystoreInstance, ComputeBackendService, KMSAutokeyConfig, BigQuery, and NotebooksInstance. These fixes address issues related to configuration mapping, reconciliation loops, immutable field updates, export tool functionality, identity and deletion resolution, perpetual diffs, and reference resolution.

entry.content:
Bug Fixes:

  • #9114: ComposerEnvironment: Support resource reference resolution and fix drift on private environment config.
  • #10414: ComputeBackendService: Prevent the automatic injection of subsetting: { policy: "NONE" } for regional backend services with INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED load balancing scheme.
  • #7222: DataprocCluster: userServiceAccountMapping field in DataprocCluster resources is now mutable.
  • #9594: DNSPolicy: Fixes to DNSPolicy for real GCP integration.
  • #10417: MemorystoreInstance: Fix crossInstanceReplicationConfig field, allowing replication roles to be synced and updated correctly.
  • #8828: NetworkSecurity: Fix UpdateAuthorizationPolicy panic with empty updateMask.
  • #7567: PrivilegedAccessManager: Fix mock drift in PrivilegedAccessManager by correcting Delete LRO and array element retention.
  • #9602: RedisCluster: Fix permanent diff caused by automated backup configuration default value.
entry.summary: This release includes several bug fixes across various resources. Key improvements address issues with ComposerEnvironment, ComputeBackendService, DataprocCluster, DNSPolicy, MemorystoreInstance, NetworkSecurity, PrivilegedAccessManager, and RedisCluster, enhancing stability and resource management.

  • Introduced Stateful Reconciliation for Direct Controllers. With stateful reconciliation, the direct controller stores a hash of the last successfully applied .spec in the resource's .status. This provides a lightweight, GitOps-safe record when a user has modified the desired state of the resource.
